rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.04 is extremely compressed, making any directional trade structurally difficult to reward adequately — a stop even one ATR away leaves almost no room before a meaningful profit target. Price is drifting modestly lower (below session VWAP of $21.30 and below the 9-EMA of $20.84) with declining candle volume, which weakens any conviction in continued momentum. Without a clear catalyst, a defined pattern structure, or historical analogs to lean on, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
